The '''Kaaga Run''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] connecting [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Shell Hutts]] used this [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between their holdings on [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]] and [[Nar Kaaga/Legends|Nar Kaaga]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
